selection_invariants.statement: SplashMX semantic transactions/conflict outcomes remain above the sync/store substrate; transport/database merge policy is never authoring authority.
Transaction identity and causal ancestry are durable; duplicate exact replay is idempotent and same-id/different-content is corruption.
Missing causal ancestors pend; relay arrival order is not semantic order.
A checkpoint is a validated semantic snapshot plus explicit causal floor; compaction never infers stability from wall time, relay head or connectivity.
Only causally-stable applied ordinary/resolution payloads may retire after checkpoint publication; compact transaction receipts remain for replay/collision evidence.
Tombstone, explicit-conflict, quarantine and protected-Asset alternative payloads remain retained in the v1 compaction policy.
Browser and native stores publish collaboration records/checkpoint metadata transactionally; interruption cannot expose a partial checkpoint or advance a coherent head.
Offline local project ownership is independent of relay/cloud availability; relay/store copies are replicas, never canonical document authority.
Presence/cursors/selections and runtime multiplayer/session/capability handles are outside durable collaboration history.
Permission epoch and schema compatibility are semantic admission inputs; stale or incompatible work remains recoverable history without authorized materialization.
A stable AssetId replacement is one complete immutable digest/source/audio/provenance/licence/derivation revision alternative; no field-wise merge is permitted.
Database row ids, offsets, SQLite pages, IndexedDB keys, relay sequence numbers and transport handles are never SplashMX semantic identity.
